title: AI System Design — Start from Requirements and Budgets
key_insight: Write measurable requirements for quality, latency, traffic, privacy, availability, and cost. Give each request a budget across the stages it crosses.
body:
## Start from Requirements and Budgets

One design promises instant answers, perfect accuracy, zero cost, and unlimited scale. Those goals conflict.

Write measurable requirements for quality, latency, traffic, privacy, availability, and cost. Give each request a budget across the stages it crosses.

Choose synchronous or queued work, caching, model size, and fallback behavior from those requirements rather than fashion.
common_mistakes: Choosing the largest model completes the entire system design.
A successful demo proves every dependency is reliable.
Production results need no record of their configuration version.
mini_exercise: Draw “Start from Requirements and Budgets” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Senior AI work requires reasoning about the whole product route rather than optimizing one model in isolation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Start from Requirements and Budgets,” explain AI System Design without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.

build_task.title: Design one AI request path
build_task.context: Turn AI System Design into one small, inspectable artifact.
steps: Draw every service and data boundary.
Add timeout, fallback, and permission decisions.
Estimate latency and cost at each stage.
build_task.expected_output: A versioned artifact with visible decisions, evidence, and failure handling.
build_task.hint: Keep the scope bounded and record why each decision was made.
